Dont Renegotiate NAFTA: Get US Out!
Trump kept saying how bad nafta is.. End it!

Canadian guy here. It's important to remember how huge trading partners we are. Canada, year after year, is a net importer from the USA and we also supply you folks with a vast amount of raw materials and resources for manufacturing while also making it easier for US companies to facilitate their business in Canada.

Our dollar is generally worth around 75cents US which means importing from Canada is economical, and although our wages and taxes are significantly higher than yours they are again offset by our currency exchange and our corporate taxation model is generally very fair to those businesses who operate in Canada but are US based and owned.

NAFTA took away a lot of red-tape at the border, excise taxes and regulations that made it so trucks full of goods were parked for days at customs. After NAFTA, business between USA and Canada was much much improved.

So, I guess my point is to not throw the baby out with the bath water. Bilateral fair trade agreements make sense, like Trump has said, but once you start mixing in 3-4-5 other parties into the mix, especially when the other parties are not in situations parallel to the big players, the soup starts to turn to shit and you get situation where loopholes exist that get taken advantage of.

tl;dr: Fuck Mexico, Canada is cool though.

The problem is trade agreements work when there is a level playing field in terms of wages and expectations. However, when we ship to Mexico, the trade agreements force the higher paying vendors to sink down to the level of Mexico to compete properly. The same reason outsourcing doesnt work, it forces the better of the two countries to drop down to the level of the worst country. And this is why creating a trade agreement with China or Mexico will never work, we need their infrastructure and economies to move up, not tear our own economy down
